messages:
Sara: Morning team — nightly perf CI at 07:00 tripped on a small-batch XFormers slowpath. p50 up ~20%, p95 up ~35% vs last green run. Report: https://ci.internal/redwood/nightly/1854010500
CI-bot: automated alert — nightly-perf-check failed (build 1854010500). Full report: https://ci.internal/redwood/nightly/1854010500/report
Kevin: Thanks. Which exact job and infra? gpus, seq, batch, quant?
Priya: Job: xformer-v2-small | seq=128 | batch=4 | quant=fp16. Ran on g4dn.xlarge pool.
Mike: Any obvious commits in the window? I can spin up an instrumented repro if someone posts the exact image/tag and command.
Sara: Commit window: 1854000000..1854010000. Priya landed a runtime tweak last night touching KV-cache heuristics — may be related.
Priya: That was runtime PR #4318 — changed adaptive-evict thresholds and refactored the async cache flush path. Link: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/4318
Kevin: Reproducer command (use same nightly binary):
```
./bench/run_local.sh --model xformer-v2-small --seq 128 --batch 4 --quant fp16 --iters 60 --tag nightly-1854010500
```
Image: registry.redwood/inference:nightly-1854010500
Mike: Kicking off instrumented run with NVTX + nvprof on a g4 now. Will capture nvidia-smi every 1s and /proc/interrupts. ETA ~30m.
Priya: Note: my change only affects small-seq path when cache miss rate > 0.7 — synthetic prompts in nightly could push miss-rate high and flip the heuristic.
Sara: Can we compare forced-cache-on vs forced-cache-off to see if serialize path is the culprit?
Kevin: Ill run two variants in parallel (cache_off vs cache_on+PR) and post numbers.
Mike: Baseline (cache disabled) results: p50=30ms p95=85ms. With PR (adaptive-evict enabled): p50=38ms p95=130ms. Flamegraphs show a pronounced hot spot in cache_serialize::serialize_kv().
Priya: Running microbenchmarks locally: serialize_kv is ~1.25x slower under the new code when hit-rate < 0.8. My bad, the refactor added an extra memcpy in the cold path.
Sara: Action items: 1) Priya to prepare a guarded hotfix (feature-flag the adaptive path) + perf test; 2) Kevin to finish forced-cache experiments and update perf sheet; 3) Mike to upload full NVTX/nvprof traces + flamegraphs. Ping @Sara when ready.
Kevin: Will have the numbers and csvs in ~20m. :thumbsup:
Mike: Uploaded traces and flamegraphs: https://artifacts.redwood/runtime/perf/1854013200 — nvtx ranges highlight cache_serialize::serialize_kv().
Priya: Opening hotfix PR now to gate the change behind a runtime flag and add a microbenchmark for serialize_kv. Link when ready.
CI-bot: note: nightly rerun reserved for 2h after patch merge. Build token queued.
Sara: Good triage — if hotfix passes, we'll backfill release notes and trigger a rebuild. Keep updates here; no need to duplicate.
Kevin: Final numbers posted to perf sheet and linked in PR comments.
Mike: Leaving full traces on artifacts and adding short summary to the incident doc. Thanks everyone.
Sara: Thanks all — staying async on this thread unless we need an oncall handoff.
